scope: Exact corrected-corpus A–S field equations; executable accumulator/source subset only. Full coupled field evolution is not implemented or claimed.

source.title: Corrected corpus — A–S transport, accumulation, threshold and feedback passages

horizon_source: Current user request; no physical/social clock calibration inferred

equations.title: Accumulated input and source
equations.display: A(t) = ∫₀ᵗ γ[U(s) − Ubaseline] ds; J(t) = κA(t)
equations.limit: Source integral starts at its declared origin. At an observation start, carry A(t₀) as unknown until sourced; do not reset history to zero.

equations.title: Signed field transport
equations.limit: S is a field over a specified spatial embedding, not a psychological percentage or two substituted scalar positions.

equations.title: Flow and incompressibility
equations.limit: This is the source mathematical analogy for social fluidity. No measured water property is imported.

equations.title: Response and threshold
equations.limit: Response-law choice stays blank. No solo/group cutoff is implied.

equations.title: Stress
equations.limit: No unprovided identification of µ₀ with another coefficient.

equations.title: Dimensional sharp-law form
equations.limit: The notes give p=P/ρ and ν=µ/ρ for constant coefficients. This form explicitly uses the sharp response.

equations.title: Sharp response alternative
equations.limit: Exactly off at and below threshold; a derivative kink at zero.

equations.title: Tanh response alternative
equations.limit: Signed negative tail is retained. No clipping and no automatic substitution.

equations.title: Exact-off response alternative
equations.display: aε(q) = 0 for q ≤ 0; aε(q) = q exp[−(ε/q)²] for q > 0
equations.limit: An explicitly distinct alternative. The optional qδ and qδ* remain separate source choices, not defaults.

structural_inputs.label: Model-time unit and observation origin
structural_inputs.would_resolve: A documented mapping; interview offsets alone are not model time.

structural_inputs.label: Spatial embedding and domain
structural_inputs.would_resolve: A specified geometry and interpretation of spatial coordinates.

structural_inputs.label: Initial field S(x,t₀)
structural_inputs.would_resolve: A sourced spatial field; not a single invented scalar.

structural_inputs.label: Initial flow u(x,t₀)
structural_inputs.would_resolve: A sourced divergence-free field and compatible boundary conditions.

structural_inputs.label: Boundary conditions
structural_inputs.would_resolve: Scalar and flow boundary conditions; zero net scalar flux cannot be assumed.

structural_inputs.label: Kₕ and source location x₀
structural_inputs.would_resolve: A smooth normalized spatial kernel on the declared domain, or a separately declared distributional source.

structural_inputs.label: Direction eₖ
structural_inputs.would_resolve: A specified unit direction and social interpretation.

structural_inputs.label: Response law a
structural_inputs.would_resolve: Choose a documented source alternative; no automatic choice.

structural_inputs.label: Gradient measure
structural_inputs.would_resolve: Original |∇S| or one explicitly selected optional source alternative.

structural_inputs.label: Solo / group mapping
structural_inputs.would_resolve: An operational observation-to-variable map. Guard averages and 0.5 are not given by these notes.

structural_inputs.label: Meaning and encounter mapping
structural_inputs.would_resolve: An operational mapping for the same person and idea. No semantic encoder is supplied by C1–C9.

history_policy: Append only. Retain all previous results, including failures and unsupported interpretations. Never label a synthetic fixture as a measurement.
